f.title: RDC 406/2020 and IN 63/2020 apply to every DRM responsible for human medicines
f.statement: RDC 406/2020 and IN 63/2020 must be observed by all Holders of Registration of Medicines (DRM) in Brazil; the term DRM covers any party responsible for medicines for human use regulated by Anvisa.
f.clause: Scope [Escopo]
f.applicability: All medicines for human use regulated by Anvisa.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Ressalta-se que estes regulamentos devem ser observados por todos os
Detentores de Registro de Medicamento (DRM) no Brasil, sendo que o
termo DRM abrange quaisquer responsáveis pelos medicamentos de uso
humano regulados pela Anvisa.
rows.location: Scope [Escopo]
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. Scope statement restating that RDC 406/IN 63 bind every DRM; "devem ser observados" = Mandatory. Review: no change; scope duty "devem ser observados" is explicit. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: "these regulations" are RDC 406/IN 63, named in the sentence before; quote proves modal and actor. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: It is emphasised that these regulations must be observed by all Holders of Registration of Medicines (DRM) in Brazil, the term DRM covering any party responsible for medicines for human use regulated by Anvisa.

f.title: All DRMs prepare the RPBR; holders of the same active substance submit on the same date when requested
f.statement: All DRMs must prepare the RPBR, and those that manufacture products with the same active substance(s) must submit them to Anvisa, when requested, always on the same date.
f.clause: Presentation [Apresentação]

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.deadline: When requested by Anvisa; same date for all holders of the same active substance(s)
rows.quote:
Ficou determinado que todos os DRM devem
elaborar o RPBR e aqueles que fabricam produtos com o(s) mesmo(s)
princípio(s) ativo(s) devem submetê-los à Anvisa, quando solicitados,
sempre na mesma data.
rows.location: Presentation [Apresentação]
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "devem elaborar" / "devem submetê-los" = Mandatory; Presentation section restating the RDC 406/IN 63 model. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves both duties, actor and "when requested, always on the same date". Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: It was determined that all DRMs must prepare the RPBR and those that manufacture products with the same active substance(s) must submit them to Anvisa, when requested, always on the same date.

f.title: Prepare an RPBR for every medicine within the time frames indicated
f.statement: Under the 2025 RPBR strategy, at this first stage all medicines shall have the RPBR prepared within the time frames indicated.
f.clause: Q1. What changed with the new RPBR strategy?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.deadline: Time frames indicated by Anvisa (see Q6)
rows.quote:
Foi alterada a periodicidade de elaboração, sendo que
neste primeiro momento todos os medicamentos deverão ter o RPBR
elaborado nos prazos indicados.
rows.location: Q1. What changed with the new RPBR strategy?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "deverão ter o RPBR elaborado" = Mandatory. Review: removed "(on the Anvisa Portal)" from the statement (not in the quote). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: "time frames indicated" are given by reference only and the rule is limited to "this first stage". Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The periodicity of preparation was changed, and at this first stage all medicines shall have the RPBR prepared within the time frames indicated.

f.title: Use the ICH E2C(R2) PBRER format for the RPBR
f.statement: The RPBR regulations remain unchanged: the RPBR format is the one presented in the ICH E2C(R2) Guideline, incorporated by RDC 406/2020 and IN 63/2020.
f.clause: Q1. What changed with the new RPBR strategy?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
A regulamentação pertinente aos RPBRs permanece a mesma, sendo o
mesmo formato do RPBR apresentado no Guia E2C(R2) do International
Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals
for Human Use (ICH), incorporado pela RDC nº 406/2020 e pela IN nº
63/2020,
rows.location: Q1. What changed with the new RPBR strategy?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. No modal verb: states that the RPBR format is that of ICH E2C(R2) as incorporated by RDC 406/IN 63; Mandatory because the format is set by the regulations. Quote cut before a line-end hyphenated word. Review: flagged no-modal Mandatory row settled: kept, because it is the only 2025 statement that the RPBR format is the ICH E2C(R2) PBRER incorporated by RDC 406/IN 63 (a binding format, not background). Level stays Mandatory; quote ends at a comma before the rationale clause. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: no modal verb in the quote; level rests on incorporation by the regulations (judgement call). Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The regulations on RPBRs remain the same, with the same RPBR format presented in the E2C(R2) Guideline of the International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH), incorporated by RDC No. 406/2020 and IN No. 63/2020,

f.title: Prepare a Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report to review the safety profile
f.statement: Holders of Registration of Medicines must prepare a Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report (RPBR) to review and evaluate the safety profile of their products, as part of Good Pharmacovigilance Practices.
f.clause: Q2. Why do companies need to prepare RPBRs?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
A obrigatoriedade de elaboração do RPBR está prevista como parte das
Boas Práticas de Farmacovigilância, conforme art. 37 da RDC 406/2020: “Os
Detentores de Registro de Medicamento devem elaborar Relatório
Periódico de Avaliação Benefício-Risco, para rever e avaliar o perfil de
segurança de seus produtos”.
rows.location: Q2. Why do companies need to prepare RPBRs?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. Quotes RDC 406 Art. 37 verbatim; "devem elaborar" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quotes RDC 406 Art. 37 verbatim; modal, actor and duty proven. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The obligation to prepare the RPBR is laid down as part of Good Pharmacovigilance Practices, under Art. 37 of RDC 406/2020: "Holders of Registration of Medicines must prepare a Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report to review and evaluate the safety profile of their products".

f.title: Keep a copy of the RPBR on file and present it to the authority on request
f.statement: Holders of Registration of Medicines must keep a copy of the RPBR on file and present it to the competent health authority whenever requested.
f.clause: Q2. Why do companies need to prepare RPBRs?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.deadline: Whenever requested by the competent health authority
rows.quote:
Os artigos nº 40 e nº 41 da RDC 406/2020 informam que “Os Detentores de
Registro de Medicamento devem manter cópia do Relatório Periódico de
Avaliação Benefício-Risco arquivada, e apresentá-la à autoridade
sanitária competente, sempre que solicitado”.
rows.location: Q2. Why do companies need to prepare RPBRs?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. Quotes RDC 406 Arts. 40-41; "devem manter ... e apresentá-la" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quotes RDC 406 Arts. 40-41; modal, actor and trigger proven. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Articles 40 and 41 of RDC 406/2020 state that "Holders of Registration of Medicines must keep a copy of the Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report on file, and present it to the competent health authority whenever requested".

f.title: In 2025 submit RPBRs only for medicines on the published list, at the listed periodicity
f.statement: Only the RPBRs of the medicines on the list published on the Anvisa Portal must be submitted to Anvisa in 2025, at the periodicities indicated in that list.
f.clause: Q5. Which medicines must have their RPBR submitted to Anvisa and at what periodicity?
f.applicability: RPBR submissions in 2025 (year-specific rule of the 2025 submission list).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.deadline: Periodicities indicated in the published list
rows.quote:
Devem ser submetidos à Anvisa em 2025 somente os RPBRs dos
medicamentos que constam na lista publicada no Portal nas periodicidades
indicadas nesta lista.
rows.location: Q5. Which medicines must have their RPBR submitted to Anvisa and at what periodicity?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "Devem ser submetidos ... somente" = Mandatory; limits 2025 submissions to listed medicines. Review: applicability notes the rule is limited to the 2025 submission cycle. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: year-specific rule for 2025 submissions, now past (review date November 2026); transitional. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Only the RPBRs of the medicines on the list published on the Portal must be submitted to Anvisa in 2025, at the periodicities indicated in that list.

f.title: RPBR preparation applies to all medicines registered with Anvisa, all regulatory categories
f.statement: RPBRs apply to all medicines registered in Brazil; RPBR preparation therefore applies to all medicines registered with Anvisa, including all registered regulatory categories.
f.clause: Q6. Which medicines must have their RPBR prepared by companies and at what periodicity?
f.applicability: All registered medicines, all regulatory categories.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
A IN nº 63/2020 esclareceu, em seu art. 2º, que “Os RPBRs são aplicados a
todos os medicamentos registrados em território nacional”. Assim, a
elaboração dos RPBRs se aplica a todos os medicamentos registrados na
Anvisa, incluindo todas as categorias regulatórias registradas.
rows.location: Q6. Which medicines must have their RPBR prepared by companies and at what periodicity?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. Quotes IN 63 Art. 2; scope of the preparation duty, Mandatory. Review: no change; scope statement kept because it extends preparation to all registered regulatory categories. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: no modal verb ("se aplica"); scope statement classed Mandatory by inference from IN 63 Art. 2. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: IN No. 63/2020 clarified, in its Art. 2, that "RPBRs apply to all medicines registered in the national territory". Thus, the preparation of RPBRs applies to all medicines registered with Anvisa, including all registered regulatory categories.

f.title: Present the RPBR to Anvisa within the Portal time frames for the active substance
f.statement: RPBR preparation is the responsibility of all Holders of Registration of Medicines, and the RPBR must be presented to Anvisa within the time frames given on the Anvisa Portal, according to the active substance involved.
f.clause: Q6. Which medicines must have their RPBR prepared by companies and at what periodicity?
f.legal_basis: IN 63/2020 Art. 2 caput and sole paragraph

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.deadline: Time frames published on the Anvisa Portal per active substance
rows.quote:
Conforme art. 2º caput e parágrafo único da IN nº 63/2020, a elaboração do
RPBR “é responsabilidade de todos os Detentores de Registro de
Medicamento, e deve ser apresentado à Anvisa nos prazos informados no
Portal da Anvisa, de acordo com o princípio ativo envolvido”.
rows.location: Q6. Which medicines must have their RPBR prepared by companies and at what periodicity?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. Quotes IN 63 Art. 2 caput and sole paragraph; "deve ser apresentado" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quotes IN 63 Art. 2 caput and sole paragraph; "deve ser apresentado" and time frames per active substance proven. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Under Art. 2 caput and sole paragraph of IN No. 63/2020, the preparation of the RPBR "is the responsibility of all Holders of Registration of Medicines, and must be presented to Anvisa within the time frames given on the Anvisa Portal, according to the active substance involved".

f.title: Maintain an annual routine of RPBR preparation and benefit-risk evaluation
f.statement: Anvisa emphasises the importance of the DRM maintaining an annual routine of preparing the RPBR and, consequently, of evaluating the benefit-risk of its products, as established by RDC 406/2020 and IN 63/2020.
f.clause: Q6. Which medicines must have their RPBR prepared by companies and at what periodicity?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Enfatiza-se a importância de que o DRM mantenha a rotina anual de
elaboração do RPBR e consequentemente da avaliação de benefício-risco
de seus produtos, conforme estabelecido pela RDC nº 406/2020 e a IN nº
63/2020.
rows.location: Q6. Which medicines must have their RPBR prepared by companies and at what periodicity?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "Enfatiza-se a importância" = emphasis, classed Recommended; the underlying preparation duty is Mandatory elsewhere (Q2, Q6). Review: no change; "Enfatiza-se a importância" = Recommended. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: level rests on an emphasis phrase not in the GUIDE language rules (judgement call). Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The importance of the DRM maintaining the annual routine of preparing the RPBR, and consequently of evaluating the benefit-risk of its products, as established by RDC No. 406/2020 and IN No. 63/2020, is emphasised.

f.title: EURD-list substances: prepare the RPBR from January 2026 within 90 days of the data lock point
f.statement: For active substances listed in the EURD list, the RPBR must be prepared, from January 2026, within 90 days of the data lock point.
f.clause: Q6, revised time frames, first bullet (EURD-list substances)
f.applicability: Active substances listed in the EU reference dates (EURD) list.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.deadline: Within 90 days of the data lock point, from January 2026
rows.quote:
Para os princípios ativos listados na EURD list: o RPBR deve ser
elaborado a partir de janeiro de 2026 em até 90 dias da data de
fechamento do banco de dados.
rows.location: Q6, revised time frames, first bullet (EURD-list substances)
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "o RPBR deve ser elaborado ... em até 90 dias" = Mandatory. Preparation deadline (not submission); submission only when listed or requested. Review: deadline confirmed: within 90 days of the data lock point, from January 2026; preparation (not submission) deadline. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves modal, deadline and start; actor (DRM) unambiguous for RPBR preparation. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: For active substances listed in the EURD list: the RPBR must be prepared from January 2026 within 90 days of the data lock point.

f.title: Set the 2026 data lock point at the International Birth Date day and month, or the EURD-list DLP
f.statement: The 2026 data lock point must be taken as the day and month of the International Birth Date of the active substance; for active substances whose data lock point (the EURD-list DLP) falls in 2026, the DLP in that list must be used.
f.clause: Q6, revised time frames, first bullet (EURD-list substances)
f.applicability: Active substances listed in the EURD list; 2026 RPBR cycle.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
A data de fechamento do banco de
dados em 2026 deve ser considerada como o dia e o mês da Data de


6
                           Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária - Anvisa
Quinta Diretoria – DIRE5
Gerência-Geral de Monitoramento de Produtos sujeitos à Vigilância Sanitária – GGMON
Gerência de Farmacovigilância – GFARM


Nascimento Internacional para o princípio ativo. Para princípios
ativos que tenham a data de fechamento do banco de dados (a DLP
da EURD list) em 2026, deve ser considerada a DLP que consta nesta
lista.
rows.location: Q6, revised time frames, first bullet (EURD-list substances)
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "deve ser considerada" = Mandatory. Quote runs across a page break and so includes the page footer/header text of page 6-7; quote_en marks it. Review: flagged page-header quote settled: kept as is, because the only header-free spans either cut "Data de Nascimento Internacional" in half or drop the IBD rule. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: quote crosses the page 6/7 footer and header; rule is specific to the 2026 cycle. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The data lock point in 2026 must be taken as the day and month of the International [page 6 footer and page header: Anvisa, DIRE5, GGMON, GFARM] Birth Date for the active substance. For active substances that have their data lock point (the DLP of the EURD list) in 2026, the DLP in that list must be used.

f.title: If the substance is not on the submission list, prepare the RPBR and keep it in the DRM's custody
f.statement: If the active substance is not on the list for submission to Anvisa, the RPBR must still be prepared and kept in the custody of the DRM.
f.clause: Q6. Which medicines must have their RPBR prepared ...
f.applicability: Active substances not on the Anvisa RPBR submission list.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Se o princípio ativo não consta na lista de submissão para a Anvisa, o RPBR
deve ser elaborado e mantido sob a guarda do DRM.
rows.location: Q6. Which medicines must have their RPBR prepared ...
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "deve ser elaborado e mantido" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves modal and both duties; actor named. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: If the active substance is not on the list for submission to Anvisa, the RPBR must be prepared and kept in the custody of the DRM.

f.title: Keep RPBRs current because Anvisa may request them at any time
f.statement: Certain circumstances may justify Anvisa requesting the RPBR from holders at any time; it is therefore important that companies maintain a routine of preparing and updating RPBRs as part of Good Pharmacovigilance Practices.
f.clause: Q6. Which medicines must have their RPBR prepared ...

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.deadline: At any time on Anvisa request
rows.quote:
Determinadas
circunstâncias podem justificar a solicitação do RPBR, a qualquer tempo,
por parte da Anvisa às empresas detentoras. Por isso é importante que as
empresas mantenham rotina de elaboração e de atualização dos RPBRs,
como parte das Boas Práticas de Farmacovigilância.
rows.location: Q6. Which medicines must have their RPBR prepared ...
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "é importante que as empresas mantenham" = Recommended; the Agency's right to request at any time is context. Review: no change; "é importante que ... mantenham" = Recommended. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: level rests on "é importante" (judgement call) and overlaps 0010. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Certain circumstances may justify a request for the RPBR from the holder companies by Anvisa at any time. It is therefore important that companies maintain a routine of preparing and updating RPBRs as part of Good Pharmacovigilance Practices.

f.title: Cover data from the last RPBR prepared for the product
f.statement: The RPBR must contain data from the last RPBR prepared for the company's product.
f.clause: Q8. Cut-off date for data retrieval

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
A elaboração do RPBR deve conter dados desde o último RPBR elaborado
do produto da empresa.
rows.location: Q8. Cut-off date for data retrieval
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "deve conter" = Mandatory. Review: removed "(cumulative since that report, not only the current year)" from the statement (question context, not the quote). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves "deve conter dados desde o último RPBR". Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The RPBR must contain data from the last RPBR prepared for the company's product.

f.title: Clones: prepare one consolidated RPBR, filed by every DRM involved, naming the products and companies
f.statement: For clone medicines, one single RPBR must be prepared containing the consolidated information on all medicines (parent and clones); it must be filed by all DRMs involved and specify which products/companies it covers.
f.clause: Q9. Can a single RPBR be filed for all clone medicines?
f.processes: Aggregate reporting; Submission operations; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
De acordo com o art. 11 da IN nº 63/2020, em situações envolvendo
medicamentos clones, 1 (um) único RPBR deve ser elaborado, contendo as
informações consolidadas de todos os medicamentos (matriz e clones), que
deve ser peticionado por todos os DRM envolvidos, com discriminação de
quais produtos/empresas estão contemplados no referido documento.
rows.location: Q9. Can a single RPBR be filed for all clone medicines?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. Quotes IN 63 Art. 11; "deve ser elaborado ... deve ser peticionado" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quotes IN 63 Art. 11; modal, actor and conditions proven. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Under Art. 11 of IN No. 63/2020, in situations involving clone medicines, one (1) single RPBR must be prepared, containing the consolidated information on all the medicines (parent and clones), which must be filed by all the DRMs involved, specifying which products/companies are covered by the document.

f.title: Clones: each holder presents the consolidated data of its own and the other holders' products
f.statement: Each registration holder of a parent or clone medicine shall present the consolidated data, containing its own products and those of the other holders.
f.clause: Q9. Can a single RPBR be filed for all clone medicines?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Portanto, cada detentor de registro deverá apresentar os dados
consolidados, contendo os seus produtos e dos demais detentores.
rows.location: Q9. Can a single RPBR be filed for all clone medicines?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "deverá apresentar" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves modal and actor; clone context from Q9. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Therefore, each registration holder shall present the consolidated data, containing its products and those of the other holders.

f.title: Clones: state in the Executive Summary which products belong to the filing company
f.statement: In a consolidated clone RPBR, the Executive Summary must clearly specify which products belong to the company making the filing.
f.clause: Q9. Can a single RPBR be filed for all clone medicines?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Destaca-
se que no Sumário Executivo deve estar especificado claramente quais
produtos são da empresa que está efetuando o protocolo.
rows.location: Q9. Can a single RPBR be filed for all clone medicines?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "deve estar especificado" = Mandatory. Quote starts after the line-end hyphenated "Destaca-se". Review: flagged mid-sentence quote settled: re-cut to start at "Destaca-se que" (line-end hyphen kept as in the text, no word joined); quote_en updated. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote now has its lead-in and proves the duty; clone context from Q9 location. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: It is highlighted that the Executive Summary must clearly specify which products belong to the company making the filing.

f.title: Clones: prepare and submit the other checklist items on the same consolidated basis
f.statement: For clone medicines, the other checklist items must follow the same (consolidated) logic for preparation and submission.
f.clause: Q9. Can a single RPBR be filed for all clone medicines?
f.applicability: Clone medicines; filing checklist for subject code 11818.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Os demais itens do checklist devem seguir a mesma lógica para elaboração
e submissão.
rows.location: Q9. Can a single RPBR be filed for all clone medicines?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "devem seguir" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: "a mesma lógica" only has meaning from the preceding Q9 answer. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The other checklist items must follow the same logic for preparation and submission.

f.title: Clones: parent and clone data may share one spreadsheet, or use separate spreadsheets
f.statement: Only for clones, the data for all parent and clone medicines may be in the same spreadsheet, relating the suspected adverse event data to the parent or clone product whenever possible; companies may also choose separate spreadsheets.
f.clause: Q9. Can a single RPBR be filed for all clone medicines?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Apenas no caso dos clones, os dados de todos os medicamentos matriz e
clones podem estar na mesma planilha, relacionando os dados de suspeita
de evento adverso ao produto matriz ou clone sempre que possível. Caso as
empresas optem por separar as planilhas, não há impedimento também.
rows.location: Q9. Can a single RPBR be filed for all clone medicines?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "podem estar" / "não há impedimento" = Permitted; "sempre que possível" kept as condition. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves both permissions and the "whenever possible" condition. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Only in the case of clones, the data for all parent and clone medicines may be in the same spreadsheet, relating the suspected adverse event data to the parent or clone product whenever possible. If the companies choose to separate the spreadsheets, there is no impediment either.

f.title: Clones with different last-report dates: cover data from the oldest report
f.statement: Where the dates of the last report of the parent and the clone differ, the report shall contain data from the oldest report so that all data are covered; the clone supplements the data in the parent's spreadsheet.
f.clause: Q9. Can a single RPBR be filed for all clone medicines?
f.applicability: Clone medicines with divergent last-report dates.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Em casos em que as datas do último relatório da matriz e do clone sejam
divergentes, o relatório deverá constar os dados a partir do relatório mais
antigo para que todos os dados estejam contemplados. Neste caso, o clone
complementa os dados da planilha da matriz.
rows.location: Q9. Can a single RPBR be filed for all clone medicines?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "deverá constar" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves modal, condition and coverage start. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Where the dates of the last report of the parent and the clone differ, the report shall contain data from the oldest report so that all data are covered. In this case, the clone supplements the data in the parent's spreadsheet.

f.title: Transfer of ownership: start from the previous holder's last RPBR and assess life-cycle data
f.statement: On transfer of registration ownership, the start date for the next RPBR shall be the date of the last report prepared by the previous registration holder; companies must evaluate the data of the medicine's whole life cycle, as they are responsible for them.
f.clause: Q10. RPBR start date on transfer of ownership
f.applicability: Transfer of registration ownership (transferência de titularidade).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Neste caso deverá ser considerada a data do último relatório elaborado pela
empresa detentora do registro anterior à transferência de titularidade. As
empresas devem avaliar os dados do ciclo de vida do medicamento, pois
são de sua responsabilidade.
rows.location: Q10. RPBR start date on transfer of ownership
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "deverá ser considerada" / "devem avaliar" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: "Neste caso" depends on the question (transfer of ownership); two duties share one row. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: In this case the date of the last report prepared by the company holding the registration before the transfer of ownership shall be used. Companies must evaluate the data of the medicine's life cycle, as they are their responsibility.

f.title: Medicines not marketed in Brazil: RPBR preparation is not required
f.statement: For medicines not marketed in Brazil, preparation of the RPBR is not necessary, provided the justifications are kept on record (see next requirement).
f.clause: Q11. Product not yet marketed in Brazil
f.applicability: Registered medicines not marketed in Brazil.
f.exceptions: Justifications must be kept on record; Anvisa may request RPBRs at any time.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Para medicamentos não comercializados no Brasil, não é necessária a
elaboração do RPBR, mas devem ser mantidas nos registros das empresas
as justificativas para que sejam apresentadas caso haja uma inspeção ou
um pedido de RPBR pela Anvisa.
rows.location: Q11. Product not yet marketed in Brazil
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "não é necessária" = Permitted; split from the Mandatory record-keeping condition in the same sentence (next row). Review: no change; "não é necessária" = Permitted. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: negated-necessity level is a judgement call and the quote is shared with 0024. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: For medicines not marketed in Brazil, preparation of the RPBR is not necessary, but the justifications must be kept in the companies' records so that they can be presented in the event of an inspection or a request for the RPBR by Anvisa.

f.title: Not-marketed medicines: keep the justification for not preparing an RPBR for inspection or request
f.statement: Where no RPBR is prepared because the medicine is not marketed in Brazil, the justifications must be kept in the company's records so that they can be presented in an inspection or on an Anvisa request for the RPBR.
f.clause: Q11. Product not yet marketed in Brazil
f.applicability: Registered medicines not marketed in Brazil.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Para medicamentos não comercializados no Brasil, não é necessária a
elaboração do RPBR, mas devem ser mantidas nos registros das empresas
as justificativas para que sejam apresentadas caso haja uma inspeção ou
um pedido de RPBR pela Anvisa.
rows.location: Q11. Product not yet marketed in Brazil
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "devem ser mantidas" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves "devem ser mantidas" and the purpose. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: For medicines not marketed in Brazil, preparation of the RPBR is not necessary, but the justifications must be kept in the companies' records so that they can be presented in the event of an inspection or a request for the RPBR by Anvisa.

f.title: Start preparing the RPBR at the Portal periodicity once marketing in Brazil begins
f.statement: As soon as the company starts to market the medicine in Brazil, it must start preparing the RPBR at the periodicity indicated on the Anvisa Portal; Anvisa may request RPBRs at any time.
f.clause: Q11. Product not yet marketed in Brazil

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.deadline: From the start of marketing, at the periodicity on the Anvisa Portal
rows.quote:
A Anvisa pode a qualquer momento
solicitar os RPBRs para as empresas, conforme RDC 406/2020. No entanto,
assim que a empresa começar a comercializar o medicamento, deve passar
a elaborar o RPBR na periodicidade indicada no Portal da Anvisa.
rows.location: Q11. Product not yet marketed in Brazil
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "deve passar a elaborar" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves "deve passar a elaborar" and the start of marketing trigger. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Anvisa may request RPBRs from companies at any time, under RDC 406/2020. However, as soon as the company starts to market the medicine, it must start preparing the RPBR at the periodicity indicated on the Anvisa Portal.

f.title: File the RPBR electronically via Solicita under subject code 11818
f.statement: When requested, RPBR filing is electronic, via Solicita, and must be made under subject code 11818 - Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report.
f.clause: Q13. Documents required at filing

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.deadline: When requested / when the substance is on the list
rows.quote:
O peticionamento é eletrônico (via Solicita) e deve ocorrer sob o código de
assunto 11818 - Relatório Periódico de Avaliação Benefício-Risco.
rows.location: Q13. Documents required at filing
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "deve ocorrer" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves Solicita and subject code 11818 with "deve ocorrer". Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Filing is electronic (via Solicita) and must be made under subject code 11818 - Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report.

f.title: Submit the RPBR form, RPBR with executive summary, data spreadsheet, conformity declaration and current leaflets
f.statement: With the RPBR filing the DRM shall present: the completed RPBR Form; the RPBR containing an Executive Summary (per IN 63/2020); the RPBR submission spreadsheet, with the medicine's data entered according to the Completion Instructions on the Anvisa portal; the Data Conformity Declaration; and the updated, approved patient and healthcare-professional package leaflets of the medicine.
f.clause: Q13. Documents required at filing

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Deverão ser
apresentados:
• Formulário RPBR preenchido ;
• Relatório Periódico de Avaliação Benefício-Risco (RPBR), contendo
Sumário Executivo (conforme Instrução Normativa nº 63/2020);

Planilha para a submissão do Relatório Periódico de Avaliação Benefício-
Risco (RPBR) . Nesta planilha deverão ser inseridos os dados do
medicamento conforme Instrução de Preenchimento, disponível no portal
da Anvisa.
• Esta planilha é uma ferramenta que permitirá uma avaliação otimizada
dos dados enviados;
• Declaração de Conformidade de dados; e
• Bulas para o paciente e para o profissional de saúde atualizadas e
aprovadas do medicamento.
rows.location: Q13. Documents required at filing
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "Deverão ser apresentados" / "deverão ser inseridos" = Mandatory. Quote contains a line-end hyphen kept as in the text. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: bullet layout of the captured list is broken (one bullet missing) and the list mixes an informational bullet; content otherwise proven. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The following shall be presented: • Completed RPBR Form; • Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report (RPBR), containing an Executive Summary (according to Normative Instruction No. 63/2020); Spreadsheet for the submission of the Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report (RPBR). The medicine's data shall be entered in this spreadsheet according to the Completion Instructions available on the Anvisa portal. • This spreadsheet is a tool that will allow an optimised evaluation of the data sent; • Data Conformity Declaration; and • Updated and approved patient and healthcare-professional package leaflets of the medicine.

f.title: Provide the other checklist documents only when the substance is listed and submitted, or on request
f.statement: The annual preparation/update duty applies to the RPBR itself, not to the other 11818 checklist documents; those must be provided when the medicine is on the list and is submitted, or when Anvisa requests them.
f.clause: Q14. Do the other checklist items (code 11818) also need annual preparation?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.deadline: At submission of a listed RPBR or on Anvisa request
rows.quote:
Não. Os outros documentos devem ser providenciados quando o
medicamento estiver na lista e for submetido ou quando houver uma
solicitação da Anvisa.
rows.location: Q14. Do the other checklist items (code 11818) also need annual preparation?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "devem ser providenciados" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves "devem ser providenciados" and both triggers. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: No. The other documents must be provided when the medicine is on the list and is submitted, or when there is a request from Anvisa.

f.title: Spreadsheet: include all cases in the RPBR's scope, national and international, since the last report
f.statement: The adverse event data in the RPBR spreadsheet must relate to the data dealt with in the related RPBR: they must contain national and international reports, if applicable, solicited and unsolicited, from spontaneous reports, studies and literature, serious and non-serious, listed and unlisted, whether or not notified, recorded in the company's (national or global) database from the last report up to the data lock point for the active substance or combination.
f.clause: Q15. Spreadsheet case-by-case data: scope and period

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Os dados de Eventos Adversos a serem incluídos na planilha devem ser
relacionados aos dados tratados no RPBR relacionado. Assim, devem estar
contidas as notificações nacionais e internacionais, se aplicável, solicitadas
e não solicitadas, advindas das notificações espontâneas, de estudos e de
literatura, dos casos graves e não graves, listados e não listados, que tenham
sido notificados ou não, registrados na base de dados da empresa (nacional
ou global) desde o último relatório até a data de fechamento para o
princípio ativo ou associação em questão.
rows.location: Q15. Spreadsheet case-by-case data: scope and period
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "devem ser relacionados" / "devem estar contidas" = Mandatory. Review: statement now keeps "if applicable" after "national and international" as in the source word order. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: long compound scope where "se aplicável" can be read as qualifying both national and international data. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The Adverse Event data to be included in the spreadsheet must relate to the data dealt with in the related RPBR. Thus, they must contain national and international reports, if applicable, solicited and unsolicited, from spontaneous reports, studies and literature, serious and non-serious cases, listed and unlisted, whether or not they were notified, recorded in the company's database (national or global) from the last report up to the data lock point for the active substance or combination concerned.

f.title: Spreadsheet data may be as at the time of database extraction
f.statement: The company may include case data in the spreadsheet as they stood at the time the data were extracted from the database.
f.clause: Q16. Case data changed by follow-up since extraction

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
A empresa pode incluir os dados na planilha conforme estavam dispostos
no momento da extração dos dados da base.
rows.location: Q16. Case data changed by follow-up since extraction
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "pode incluir" = Permitted. Review: removed "even if follow-up has since changed them" from the statement (question context). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves "pode incluir". Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The company may include the data in the spreadsheet as they stood at the time the data were extracted from the database.

f.title: Spreadsheet causality column: enter the company's causality assessment
f.statement: The causality assessment to be entered in the RPBR spreadsheet is the company's, not the reporter's.
f.clause: Q17. Causality column: reporter or company?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: A avaliação de causalidade a ser incluída é da empresa.
rows.location: Q17. Causality column: reporter or company?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. No modal verb ("a ser incluída é da empresa" = the one to be included is the company's); classed Mandatory as a data-entry rule. Reviewer to confirm level. Review: flagged no-modal Mandatory row settled: kept, because "a avaliação de causalidade a ser incluída é da empresa" is a data-entry instruction ("to be included") for a required spreadsheet column, not background. Level Mandatory. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: no modal verb; level inferred from "a ser incluída" (judgement call). Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The causality assessment to be included is the company's.

f.title: Any established or in-house causality method may be used
f.statement: For the causality assessment, the company may use an established method or its own method.
f.clause: Q18. Is a specific causality algorithm required?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Para a avaliação de causalidade, a empresa pode utilizar algum método
estabelecido ou método próprio.
rows.location: Q18. Is a specific causality algorithm required?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "pode utilizar" = Permitted. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: "pode utilizar" = Permitted, proven. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: For the causality assessment, the company may use an established method or its own method.

f.title: Map causality results to the four Anvisa values: Definida, Possibilidade, Positiva Indefinida, Não Relacionada
f.statement: Whatever method is used, the company must map its causality values to one of four values: Definite (Definida: certain the medicine caused the AE); Possible (Possibilidade: possible or probable that it did); Positive undefined (Positiva Indefinida: not known whether it did); Not related (Não Relacionada: certain it did not).
f.clause: Q18. Is a specific causality algorithm required?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.location: Q18. Is a specific causality algorithm required?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "O que é necessário" = Mandatory (necessity). Four category labels kept in Portuguese in the statement. Review: no change; "é necessário" = Mandatory (necessity). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves the mapping duty and the four values. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: What is necessary is to map its values to one of the four values below: • Definite: it is certain that the medicine was responsible for the adverse event; • Possible: it is possible or probable that the medicine was responsible for the adverse event; • Positive undefined: it is not known whether or not the medicine was responsible for the adverse event; • Not related: it is certain that the medicine was not responsible for the adverse event.

f.title: Adapt unmapped causality terms to one of the four Anvisa values
f.statement: The "Spreadsheet completion instructions" give a table relating the four values to the mapped causality methods; if the company's causality terms are not covered, it must adapt them and replace them with one of the four terms.
f.clause: Q18. Is a specific causality algorithm required?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Vide, no documento de “Instruções de preenchimento da planilha”, a tabela
de relação destes valores com os atribuídos aos métodos de avaliação de
causalidade mapeados. Caso os termos para avaliação de causalidade
utilizada pela empresa não estejam contemplados, é necessário fazer uma
adaptação e substituí-los por um dos quatro termos acima.
rows.location: Q18. Is a specific causality algorithm required?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "é necessário fazer uma adaptação" = Mandatory. Review: no change; "é necessário" = Mandatory. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves the adaptation duty and its condition. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: See, in the "Spreadsheet completion instructions" document, the table relating these values to those assigned by the mapped causality assessment methods. If the causality assessment terms used by the company are not covered, it is necessary to adapt them and replace them with one of the four terms above.

f.title: Total units sold in all countries includes Brazil, per presentation
f.statement: The spreadsheet field "Total units sold in all countries", if applicable, is the total number of presentations sold worldwide or in the countries correlated to the adverse event database reported, including Brazil, for each presentation.
f.clause: Q20. Total units sold in all countries

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
O Total de Unidades Vendidas em todos os países, se aplicável, refere-se ao
valor numérico, informando o total de apresentações vendidas no mundo
ou nos países correlacionados ao banco de dados de Eventos Adversos
informado, incluindo o Brasil, para cada apresentação informada.
rows.location: Q20. Total units sold in all countries
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. Field definition with no modal verb; classed Recommended (guidance on how to fill a field). Review: field definition kept as Recommended (it sets what figure goes in a required spreadsheet field; GUIDE: non-binding definition = Recommended). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: definition with no modal verb; level per GUIDE definition rule. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The Total Units Sold in all countries, if applicable, refers to the numerical value giving the total number of presentations sold worldwide or in the countries correlated to the Adverse Event database reported, including Brazil, for each presentation reported.

f.title: Clone cases handled by the parent: give the worldwide unique case ID as coded at source
f.statement: Where clone companies' notifications are handled and coded by the parent company, the spreadsheet must give the Worldwide Unique Identification as coded in the source database of the data.
f.clause: Q23. Clone cases notified by the parent company
f.applicability: Clone medicines whose cases are processed by the parent company.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
No caso das notificações de empresas clones serem tratadas pela empresa
matriz e serem codificadas por ela, deve ser informada, na planilha, a
Identificação Única no Mundo, conforme codificada na base de origem do
dado.
rows.location: Q23. Clone cases notified by the parent company
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "deve ser informada" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves "deve ser informada" and the condition; actor (filing DRM) unambiguous. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Where the notifications of clone companies are handled by the parent company and coded by it, the Worldwide Unique Identification must be reported in the spreadsheet, as coded in the data's source database.

f.title: Name the spreadsheet RPBRNomeAtivo-Empresa-dd.mm.aaaa using the list's submission date
f.statement: The company shall save and name the RPBR spreadsheet as RPBRNomeAtivo-Empresa-dd.mm.aaaa, where NomeAtivo is the active substance name as in the RPBR list, Empresa is the name of the company or companies whose data are in the spreadsheet, and dd.mm.aaaa is the RPBR submission date from the list.
f.clause: Q24. Naming the RPBR spreadsheet

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
A empresa deverá salvar e nomear a planilha da seguinte forma:
RPBRNomeAtivo-Empresa-dd.mm.aaaa, sendo:

- NomeAtivo: o nome do princípio ativo conforme disposto na lista de RPBR
- Empresa: nome da empresa ou das empresas das quais constam dados na
planilha
- dd.mm.aaaa: a data de submissão do RPBR da lista
rows.location: Q24. Naming the RPBR spreadsheet
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "deverá salvar e nomear" = Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote proves modal, actor and naming pattern. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The company shall save and name the spreadsheet as follows: RPBRNomeAtivo-Empresa-dd.mm.aaaa, where: - NomeAtivo: the name of the active substance as given in the RPBR list - Empresa: name of the company or companies whose data are in the spreadsheet - dd.mm.aaaa: the RPBR submission date from the list

f.title: Keep the spreadsheet structure: do not rename tabs or columns
f.statement: The spreadsheet may be completed in either language since most data are codes or numbers, but it is important to keep its structure, without changing the names of tabs and columns, for example.
f.clause: Q25. Spreadsheet in English or Portuguese?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
A maioria dos dados da planilha são códigos ou numéricos, de forma que o
fator do idioma a ser utilizado não gera impacto. No entanto, é importante
manter a estrutura da planilha, sem mudar os nomes de abas e colunas, por
exemplo.
rows.location: Q25. Spreadsheet in English or Portuguese?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "é importante manter" = Recommended. Review: no change; "é importante manter" = Recommended. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: level rests on "é importante" (judgement call). Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Most of the spreadsheet data are codes or numbers, so the language used has no impact. However, it is important to keep the structure of the spreadsheet, without changing the names of tabs and columns, for example.

f.title: Give the active substance name in Portuguese, identical to the RPBR list
f.statement: In the spreadsheet the name of the active substance must be in Portuguese, identical to the name given in the RPBR list for the active substance or combination.
f.clause: Q25. Spreadsheet in English or Portuguese?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
E o nome do princípio ativo deve estar em português, pois deve
ser IDÊNTICO ao disposto na lista do RPBR para o princípio ativo ou
associação.
rows.location: Q25. Spreadsheet in English or Portuguese?

rows.quote_en: And the name of the active substance must be in Portuguese, because it must be IDENTICAL to that given in the RPBR list for the active substance or combination.

f.title: "Confirmed by a healthcare professional" means later confirmation of a lay-reported event by an HCP
f.statement: Following ICH E2B(R3), the "confirmed by a healthcare professional" information indicates whether the occurrence of the event was subsequently confirmed and qualified by a healthcare professional.
f.clause: Q26. What does the Agency understand by "Confirmed by Healthcare Professional"?
f.applicability: Events reported by a patient or other reporter who is not a healthcare professional (lead-in of the Q26 answer); RPBR spreadsheet field.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
se o caso foi confirmado por um profissional de saúde indica se a ocorrência
do evento foi subsequentemente confirmada e qualificada por um
profissional de saúde.
rows.location: Q26. What does the Agency understand by "Confirmed by Healthcare Professional"?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. Definition (no modal verb) of a spreadsheet field taken from ICH E2B(R3); classed Recommended. Quote runs across a page break and includes the page 12 footer/page header text. Review: flagged page-header quote settled: re-cut to the header-free definition after the page break; the lay-reporter condition from the lead-in moved to applicability; quote_en updated. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: definition with no modal verb; quote now lacks its lead-in (lay reporter) to avoid page-header text. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: whether the case was confirmed by a healthcare professional indicates whether the occurrence of the event was subsequently confirmed and qualified by a healthcare professional.

f.title: Generic medicines: enter the active substance name as product name
f.statement: For generic medicines, the Product Name field of the spreadsheet must contain the name of the active substance.
f.clause: Q27. Product name for generic medicines

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
No caso de medicamentos genéricos, no Nome do Produto, incluir o nome
do princípio ativo.
rows.location: Q27. Product name for generic medicines
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. Imperative infinitive instruction ("incluir") read as Mandatory. Review: flagged no-modal Mandatory row settled: kept, because "incluir o nome do princípio ativo" is an imperative infinitive instruction for a required field. Level Mandatory. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: imperative infinitive, level is a judgement call. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: For generic medicines, in Product Name, include the name of the active substance.

f.title: Present sales data for cumulative and interval patient exposure (IN 63 Art. 12 V b)
f.statement: As exposure is calculated from units sold, it is recommended that sales data be presented to meet item b (patient exposure from marketing experience) of IN 63/2020 Art. 12 section V.
f.clause: Q28. Patient exposure (IN 63 Art. 12 V b): prescriptions data?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Assim como padronizado na planilha, o cálculo de exposição será feito a
partir de unidades vendidas. Desta forma, recomenda-se que para
atendimento ao item b da IN 63/2020, seja apresentado dados de vendas.
rows.location: Q28. Patient exposure (IN 63 Art. 12 V b): prescriptions data?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "recomenda-se" = Recommended. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: "recomenda-se" = Recommended, proven with its purpose. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: As standardised in the spreadsheet, the exposure calculation will be made from units sold. Accordingly, it is recommended that, to meet item b of IN 63/2020, sales data be presented.

f.title: Other exposure parameters (e.g. prescription data) may be added
f.statement: Other forms of parametrisation (of patient exposure) may be added to the sales data.
f.clause: Q28. Patient exposure (IN 63 Art. 12 V b): prescriptions data?

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: Outras formas de parametrização podem ser acrescidas.
rows.location: Q28. Patient exposure (IN 63 Art. 12 V b): prescriptions data?
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. "podem ser acrescidas" = Permitted. Review: removed "(such as prescription data)" from the statement (question context). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: the quote alone does not say what is being parametrised (patient exposure, from the lead-in). Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Other forms of parametrisation may be added.

f.title: Generics and similars: include risk characterisation (IN 63 Art. 12 XVI d) in the RPBR
f.statement: The RPBR topics of IN 63/2020 Art. 12 must be covered; the "risk characterisation" sub-item (d) of section XVI "Evaluation of Signals and Risks" also applies to generic and similar medicines.
f.clause: Q29. Risk characterisation for generics and similars

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
29. O Art. 12 da IN 63/2020 estabelece os tópicos que devem ser
contemplados na elaboração do RPBR. No inciso XVI do art. 12 “Avaliação
de Sinais e Riscos”, a alínea d “caracterização de riscos” é aplicável à
genéricos e similares?

Sim.
rows.location: Q29. Risk characterisation for generics and similars
rows.review_note: Extraction pass (provisional, capped at 89): current 2nd edition (v2.0, 04/07/2025) of the Anvisa RPBR Q&A, which replaces v1.0 of 19/11/2020. Answer is "Sim." to a question that restates that IN 63 Art. 12 topics "devem ser contemplados"; quote therefore includes the question. Mandatory. Review: no change. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90: the modal is in the question restating IN 63 Art. 12; the answer is "Sim." Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: 29. Art. 12 of IN 63/2020 sets out the topics that must be covered when preparing the RPBR. In section XVI of Art. 12 "Evaluation of Signals and Risks", is sub-item d "risk characterisation" applicable to generics and similars? Yes.

dates.title: Anvisa RPBR Q&A 2nd edition: RPBRs for EURD-list substances prepared under the revised time frames from January 2026
dates.scope: Registration holders of medicines whose active substances are on the EURD list (RPBR prepared within 90 days of the data lock point)
dates.quote: o RPBR deve ser elaborado a partir de janeiro de 2026 em até 90 dias da data de fechamento do banco de dados.
dates.quote_en: the RPBR must be prepared from January 2026 within 90 days of the data lock point.
dates.location: Q6, revised time frames, first bullet (EURD-list substances)
dates.timing_note: The source states the month only ('a partir de janeiro de 2026'); the first day of the month is used. For substances not on the EURD list, Anvisa was to publish a list by the end of 2025, with no fixed date for companies.
